description: This file contains selector functions for accessing and manipulating post-related data within the Mattermost Redux state, including retrieving posts, reactions, thread information, and various post properties.

methods.name: getAllPosts
methods.description: Retrieves all posts from the global state.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Retrieves a specific post by ID from the state.

methods.name: isPostFlagged
methods.description: Checks if a post is flagged by the user.

methods.name: getPostRepliesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of replies for a given post.

methods.name: getPostsInThread
methods.description: Returns the relation of posts in threads.

methods.name: getPostsInThreadOrdered
methods.description: Returns ordered list of post IDs in a thread, including the root post.

methods.name: getReactionsForPosts
methods.description: Returns reactions associated with posts.

methods.name: makeGetReactionsForPost
methods.description: Creates a selector to get reactions for a specific post.

methods.name: getHasReactions
methods.description: Checks if a post has any reactions.

methods.name: getOpenGraphMetadata
methods.description: Returns OpenGraph metadata for posts.

methods.name: getOpenGraphMetadataForUrl
methods.description: Retrieves OpenGraph metadata for a specific URL in a post.

methods.name: getPostIdsInCurrentChannel
methods.description: Gets IDs of posts loaded in the current channel.

methods.name: makeGetPostIdsForThread
methods.description: Creates a selector to get post IDs in a thread.

methods.name: makeGetPostsChunkAroundPost
methods.description: Creates a selector to get a chunk of posts around a specific post.

methods.name: getLatestInteractablePostId
methods.description: Gets the latest interactable post ID in a channel or thread.

methods.name: getLatestPostToEdit
methods.description: Gets the latest post ID that the current user can edit.

methods.name: getLatestReplyablePostId
methods.description: Gets the latest replyable post ID in the current channel.

methods.name: getPostsInCurrentChannel
methods.description: Retrieves recent posts in the current channel, filtering join/leave messages.

methods.name: makeGetPostsForThread
methods.description: Creates a selector to get posts in a thread, including the root post.

methods.name: makeGetProfilesForThread
methods.description: Creates a selector to get user profiles involved in a thread.

methods.name: makeGetCommentCountForPost
methods.description: Creates a selector to count comments for a post.

methods.name: getSearchResults
methods.description: Retrieves posts matching search results.

methods.name: getSearchMatches
methods.description: Returns search match highlights if available.

methods.name: makeGetMessageInHistoryItem
methods.description: Creates a selector to get a message in history by type.

methods.name: makeGetPostsForIds
methods.description: Creates a selector to get posts for a list of IDs.

methods.name: getMostRecentPostIdInChannel
methods.description: Gets the most recent post ID in a channel, excluding system messages if specified.

methods.name: getRecentPostsChunkInChannel
methods.description: Gets the most recent chunk of posts in a channel.

methods.name: getOldestPostsChunkInChannel
methods.description: Gets the oldest chunk of posts in a channel.

methods.name: getOldestPostTimeInChannel
methods.description: Returns timestamp of the oldest post in a channel.

methods.name: getPostIdsInChannel
methods.description: Returns IDs of posts loaded at the bottom of a channel.

methods.name: getPostsChunkInChannelAroundTime
methods.description: Gets a chunk of posts around a specific timestamp.

methods.name: getUnreadPostsChunk
methods.description: Gets the chunk of unread posts around a timestamp.

methods.name: isPostsChunkIncludingUnreadsPosts
methods.description: Checks if a post chunk includes unread posts based on timestamp.

methods.name: isPostIdSending
methods.description: Checks if a post ID is currently being sent.

methods.name: makeIsPostCommentMention
methods.description: Creates a selector to determine if a post comment mentions the current user.

methods.name: getLimitedViews
methods.description: Retrieves limited views state for posts.

methods.name: isPostPriorityEnabled
methods.description: Checks if post priority feature is enabled.

methods.name: isPostAcknowledgementsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if post acknowledgements are enabled.

methods.name: getAllowPersistentNotifications
methods.description: Checks if persistent notifications are allowed.

methods.name: getPersistentNotificationMaxRecipients
methods.description: Retrieves max recipients for persistent notifications.

methods.name: getPersistentNotificationIntervalMinutes
methods.description: Retrieves interval minutes for persistent notifications.

methods.name: getAllowPersistentNotificationsForGuests
methods.description: Checks if persistent notifications are allowed for guests.

methods.name: getPostAcknowledgements
methods.description: Retrieves acknowledgements for a post.

methods.name: isPersistentNotificationsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if persistent notifications are enabled for the current user.

methods.name: makeGetPostAcknowledgementsWithProfiles
methods.description: Creates a selector to get acknowledgements with user profiles.

methods.name: getTeamIdFromPost
methods.description: Retrieves the team ID associated with a post.
